Design note · Klaxoon K1 parity (#20): same 3 sections and 11 questions plus the sole-prop “registered?” follow-up (KN-01). Layout (#21): one row per question in 3 section cards, with the question on the left and the answer on the right, like 04.1. The 2-question router (CA-S1-a, OQ-79) and the consequence helper lines (CA-S1-c) were withdrawn because the page was longer than Klaxoon; only Klaxoon’s own help lines remain. Wording is plain-language UX copy; the final list comes from Business in Excel (KN-02, OQ-70).
Design note · Answers carry forward: structure and the sole-prop answer prefill 04.1, and the owner and signer counts prefill 05.1, so nobody answers the same question twice (OQ-96). Knock-out answers still route to 02.3 / 02.4; invitees arrive from their email link (11.x).
